summary: ALX Oncology Holdings Inc. filed Form 8-K reporting the resignation of Chairman Corey Goodman for personal reasons, effective June 29, 2026, with no disagreement cited. The Board appointed independent director Scott Garland as Chairman and adjusted committee chairs. No deal terms, price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. This is a non-disruptive board transition, not a forced departure. Watch for any subsequent strategic shifts or investor reaction.
